review_evidence: All 307 current primary files in the Rocq success-test unit were inventoried; 278 own common declaration forms, totaling about 3,671 definitions, lemmas, records, inductives, examples and goals.

AdvancedCanonicalStructure.v contains a nontrivial `img` record, canonical structures, lemmas and a typed term reification development; other declaration-dense files include cbn_hott.v, polymorphism.v, simpl.v, Cases.v, Fixpoint.v, Typeclasses.v and coercions.v.

The 29 declaration-light files test parser/module/tactic behavior but path naming does not prove that they carry no reusable formal-language examples; no exact subset was shown lossless enough for hard exclusion.
summary: Retain the Rocq success-test formal corpus: it contains thousands of miniature formal declarations and language/interface examples, with no proven lossless hard-exclusion subset.
